{{Quote|A bomb! A bomb on the skybridge!|A Jedi after the Draay Estate was destroyed during Vindication|<ref name="Kotor">[[Knights of the Old Republic 32|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 32]]</ref>}}
A '''skybridge''' was a type of structure that stretched over the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]. One was located in the [[Draay Estate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], it was destroyed during [[Vindication]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]]'s fleet, while being crossed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who had been rallied against the [[Jedi Covenant]].<ref name="Kotor" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] speculated that [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] would return to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] via the skybridges of the [[Vis district]].<ref name="Endgame">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>
